title: Oven Roasted French Beef Macaron
description: A pungent and molten weeknight French dish featuring tarragon and a macaron form, this recipe is macrobiotic-friendly and perfect for a dinner meal. It combines the flavors of Burgundy with the uniqueness of a spherified macaron.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, tarragon, onion, and garlic, mixing well with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined.
In a separate bowl, mix the almond flour, egg whites, salt, and black pepper to form a macaron batter.
Spoon the macaron batter into a piping bag fitted with a round tip.
Pipe the batter into small, round shapes onto a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Place a small spoonful of the beef mixture onto one half of each macaron shape.
Fold the other half of the macaron over the beef to form a sphere, pressing the edges together to seal.
Place the macarons on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast in the preheated oven for 15 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees Fahrenheit and continue roasting for an additional 10 minutes, or until the macarons are golden brown and the beef is cooked through.
